Code blocks

Shiki writes one span per line with newlines between them.

const a = 1;
const b = 2;

SyntaxHighlighter lays code out as a table with a gutter of line numbers.

1
2
 
$.ajax({
});

Prism in Docusaurus ends every line with a br element instead of a newline.

let x = 1;
x++;

Some highlighters put a line number inside every line.

1print("hi")
2print("bye")
